about: The 6 CHiPS heads used in the second evaluation (chosen again after the relabeling of section 8, layers 6 to 12).
direction: Each head is weakened along the direction of its own layer (r_L, the mean difference at the last prompt position between build questions whose no-edit reply had a disclaimer and questions whose reply had none, in that layer). CHiPS removes strength x (r_L . v) x r_L from the head's output v. Strengths were allocated by gne's head-component pipeline (cap 30 per head). Model: Qwen3.5-4B, Q8_0 GGUF.
